posts.title: Distant Train
posts.description: It's still winter but I have my office window open a crack to let fresh air in. In the distance I heard a train horn. This is such a lonely, but calming sound on top of the general hum of the city and the nearby harbour.

posts.title: Practice Painting Highway Lines
posts.description: Sometimes the folks who paint lines on the road need to practice. In Halifax, it looks like this happens on Bayne Street.

posts.title: Vintage Market leave-behinds
posts.description: Have you ever gone into a vintage market, antique shop, or junk dealer only to reminisce about that thing you didn't pick up? One of those items for me is this vintage space-themed lunchbox. A great illustration, good colours, and plenty of weathering to show it had a life before me. I didn't buy it, but I do have this photo as a memory.
